brief.briefText:
VISUAL BRIEF
Topic: Addition (G2-MATH-T1-03), Grade 2, Mathematics. Language of teaching: English.
Learning purpose: Help learners see that adding joins two groups to make one bigger group.
Format and use: A4 landscape classroom poster for Grade 2 learners
Must show:
- Two small groups of counters, clearly separate
- The same counters joined into one group
- The number sentence 4 + 3 = 7 in large type
Must avoid:
- Cluttered backgrounds
- More than ten objects
- Anything that looks like a real child or a brand
- Real or identifiable children and adults
- Brand names, logos and copyrighted characters
- Text in any language other than the language of teaching unless stated
Alt text: Four counters and three counters joined into a group of seven, with the sum 4 + 3 = 7.
